sources.content: # AGENTS.md for Hexmorrow. Hexmorrow is a server-rendered web framework written in TypeScript. The repository is a pnpm workspace with the core runtime in `packages/hm-core` and the router in `packages/hm-router`. Use Node 20; the `.nvmrc` file pins 20.11.1. Install with `pnpm install` and build every package with `pnpm -r build`. Unit tests run with `pnpm test`, which calls Vitest. The end-to-end suite in `e2e/` uses Playwright and must run against a dev server started on port 4100 with `pnpm dev:e2e`. Do not commit the `dist/` folders; the build produces them.

Rules for agents. Route files live under `app/routes/` and export a default function named `render`. Every new public API needs a changeset created with `pnpm changeset` in the same pull request. Keep the bundle size of `hm-core` under 40 KB gzipped; CI fails above that limit through the `size-check` job. Do not add runtime dependencies to `hm-core` without an issue that a maintainer has labeled `deps-approved`. Use named exports only, except in route files. Branch names follow `type/short-name`, for example `fix/router-params`.

claims.text: The size-check job fails CI when hm-core exceeds 40 KB gzipped.
Every new public API in Hexmorrow needs a changeset in the same pull request.
Hexmorrow route files export a default function named handler.
The Hexmorrow router lives in packages/hm-router.
